description:
OUR MISSION: HOSPITAL-QUALITY CARE, EVERYWHERE.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!




OUR VALUES: THE PRINCIPLES THAT GUIDE US

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

 - We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.

 - We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.

 - We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.

 - We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.
   
   


THE OPPORTUNITY

Verse Medical is hiring a RevOps Analyst / GTM Engineer. This role is a critical hire as we build out the revenue operations function at Verse. This is one role with two halves. The analyst half answers the questions leadership cannot answer today: where pipeline comes from, where it stalls, and what the forecast actually is. The GTM engineer half builds the systems that stop those questions from being asked again: the Salesforce object model, the routing rules, the data pipelines, the automations and agents.



We sell to health systems, discharge planners, case managers, and post-acute partners, which means one health system is many locations and many referral sources rather than one account. That shape makes territory design, routing, and pipeline analysis harder than a typical logo-based motion, and worth doing well.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no team and no backlog waiting for you. If you want to write only SQL, or only administer Salesforce, this is not the right role. If you want to find a broken revenue process and fix it end to end, it is.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline and Forecast Operations

 - Run pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and weekly revenue reporting with accurate data, clear summaries, and tracked follow-up.

 - Monitor stage progression, conversion rates, sales cycle length, deal slippage, stale opportunities, close-date hygiene, and loss reasons, and say what they mean, not just what they are.

 - Partner with sales leadership and AEs to improve pipeline inspection, deal movement, and accountability without adding unnecessary admin work.

 - Own target account, territory, ownership, and routing logic as the team scales, including the fact that one health system is many locations and many referral sources, not one account.

 - Model quotas, capacity, and comp plans, and produce the numbers that pay people correctly.

CRM, Data, and AI-Native Operations

 - Own Salesforce as a system, not a database: object model, fields, validation rules, flows, and permissions. Make the CRM reflect how we actually sell.
 - Own day-to-day hygiene for required fields, lifecycle and stage accuracy, source attribution, account and contact quality, and data completeness.
 - Design, test, and roll out workflows that improve fill rates, enforce required fields, flag stale or low-quality data, and reduce manual cleanup.

 [...] WHAT YOU BRING
Experience
 - 2+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM operations, business operations, or analytics supporting a sales team. Time in a growth-stage company where you built rather than maintained counts for more than years on a résumé.
 - Strong understanding of GTM metrics, pipeline mechanics, forecast support, CRM hygiene, and sales process discipline.
 - Ownership of a system end to end. You have been the person accountable for a CRM, a reporting layer, or a GTM data pipeline, not a requester of tickets.
 - Comfort with ambiguity and no playbook. You will decide what matters most this month.
Technical Skills

description:
THE ROLE

 - Tenex embeds engineering pods inside Fortune 500 companies to build and ship AI systems. Our AI Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers work directly with client teams from the first week of an engagement, which means every person we hire has to be capable of representing us in a senior client environment almost immediately.

 - We are growing from 50 people to 150. That is approximately 100 hires, and the majority of them are Strategist and Engineer roles with a high bar and a competitive market.

 - Hiring is currently the most important and most difficult constraint on this business. It determines which engagements we can win, how well we deliver them, and how quickly we can grow. Nothing else we do matters if we cannot consistently find and assess the right people.

 - We will not reach 150 people by repeating the process that got us to 50. This role exists to build a hiring process that is repeatable, measurable, and fast enough to support that growth, and then to run it.

 - You will own the top of the funnel and candidate screening. That means you will source candidates, run outreach, conduct first round conversations, and determine who moves forward in the process.

 - This is an entry level role with an unusual amount of responsibility. You will speak with more candidates in your first year than most recruiters do in three, and your assessments will directly influence who we hire.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Sourcing and outreach

 - You will identify and source candidates from MBB firms, Big 4 consultancies, Palantir, and AI-native companies, and you will develop new sources as the existing ones are exhausted.

 - You will write and run outbound campaigns over LinkedIn and email, and you will own the quality of that writing rather than sending templates someone else wrote.

 - You will test messaging variants against one another, measure reply and conversion rates, and discontinue approaches that do not perform.



Screening

 - You will conduct first round conversations with candidates across both the Strategist and Forward Deployed Engineer tracks, which requires you to understand what strong performance looks like in each.

 - You will assess candidates against our rubrics for technical depth, client presence, and ownership, and you will help improve those rubrics as you learn where they produce the wrong answer.

 - You will make screening recommendations and explain your reasoning to hiring managers, including in the cases where they initially disagree with your read.



Hiring data

 - You will own our hiring metrics, including pass through rates by stage and by source, time to offer, offer acceptance rate, and the points in the process where candidates most often withdraw.

 - You will present those numbers in weekly hiring reviews and recommend specific changes based on what they show, rather than reporting them and waiting for direction.



Process and documentation

 - You will maintain our compressed one week interview loop as candidate volume increases, which becomes meaningfully harder as more interviewers and more open roles enter the process.

 - You will document what works clearly enough that the next person we add to this team can execute it without your involvement.

 - You will identify the points where the process slows down or produces inconsistent outcomes, and you will propose and implement fixes.



Forward planning

 - You will build candidate relationships for roles we expect to open in the next two quarters, not only for roles that are open today.




CAREER PROGRESSION

 - We want to be direct about how this role is intended to develop, because it is a significant part of what makes it worth taking.

 - This is not a permanent recruiting role. We are hiring you into talent because talent is the largest constraint on the business right now, and we need someone capable to own it.

 - After approximately twelve to eighteen months, assuming you have built a process that runs reliably and can be handed to someone else, we expect to move you into whatever the largest constraint on the business is at that time.
 - We cannot tell you today what that will be. Based on where the company is heading, the most likely areas are delivery operations, finance and revenue operations, client operations, or a role directly supporting our commercial function.
 - What we can commit to is that we will move you toward the hardest available problem rather than leaving you in a role you have already solved. That is the basis on which we expect you to join, and it is how we intend to develop the people in this seat.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 - You have between zero and two years of full time experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply, and we are more interested in how you think and communicate than in where you have previously worked.
 - You write clearly and persuasively, because the majority of your first interactions with candidates will happen in writing and the quality of that writing determines whether they respond at all.
 - You are comfortable being given an incomplete brief and working out the rest independently, and you will ask for direction when you need it rather than stalling.
 - You can build a funnel model in a spreadsheet without needing to be taught how, and you are comfortable defending the assumptions behind it.
 - You can sustain a high volume of conversations and frequent rejection, both from candidates who decline us and from candidates you have to decline.
 - You have genuine interest in AI and in what separates a strong engineer or strategist from an average one, because you cannot accurately screen for capabilities you do not understand yourself.
 [...] WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 - This is not a coordination role centered on scheduling and interview logistics.
 [...]  - This is not a remote role. Our team works from our New York office, and the screening work benefits substantially from proximity to the hiring managers you support.

location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As a GTM Strategy & Operations Business Partner supporting the AMER Enterprise Tech organization, you will work closely with sales leadership to be a deep expert in a critical segment of our fastest-growing business. This role supports the AMER Enterprise Tech team, one of Anthropic's largest and most strategically significant commercial organizations, and will partner directly with executives to drive strategic analysis, operational efficiency, and growth initiatives while supporting critical global strategic initiatives.
 This includes business performance analysis, facilitating operating cadences and powering business reviews, improving operational efficiency, driving strategic initiatives, and supporting the rapid evolution of our sales motions and organization.
 We're building for a future where AI dramatically amplifies what strategy teams can accomplish. We're hiring people with the technical depth, business judgment, and executive potential to operate at that frontier — leveraging AI to eliminate routine work and redirect energy toward the strategic and creative challenges that move the business. This role will evolve rapidly, and we need someone with the ceiling and ambition to evolve with it.
 Key responsibilities
 Strategic Analysis, Operations & Planning
- Partner with Sales leaders to analyze and refine segment-specific strategy including territory planning, resource allocation, performance to plan, and growth initiatives
- Maintain excellence through business reviews and operating cadences to help achieve company revenue targets and strategic objectives
- Be audible-ready about GTM efforts and a deep expert in your segment's book of business and trends with the ability to cut right to what matters for varying audiences from IC to executive
 Data-Driven Decision Support
- Analyze sales performance metrics and develop insights to optimize segment performance and improve efficiency using SQL, R, or Python to query, model, and visualize data at scale
- Leverage Claude to its full capability
- Partner to create, evolve and maintain reporting mechanisms, using data to go from "what" to "why"
- Synthesize tangible, strategic recommendations based on go-to-market motions, deal outcomes, partner and customer feedback, and product opportunities
- Build and maintain dashboards, models, and ad hoc analyses in spreadsheets and BI tools with mastery-level proficiency
 Go-to-Market Execution
- Develop and maintain use case frameworks to capture and standardize how customers derive value
- Support multiple teams and executives in leveraging insights for new deals, expansions, and retention strategies
- Partner with GTM teams to evolve and refine sales motions and best practices across segments and regions
 Executive Stakeholder Management
- Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior and executive stakeholders across the GTM organization, delivering insights and recommendations with clarity, conviction, and composure
- Navigate high-stakes conversations with intense, demanding executives — maintaining poise under pressure while delivering candid, well-supported perspectives
- Build deep credibility through consistent follow-through, proactive communication, and the ability to challenge assumptions respectfully when the data warrants it
- Translate complex analyses into executive-ready narratives that drive decisions, managing up effectively across multiple senior leaders with competing priorities
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement, Strategic Finance, and Product teams to drive initiatives and elevate excellence in course of business
 [...]  Minimum qualifications 
- Deep alignment to Anthropic’s mission
- Experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, management consulting
- Proficiency in SQL or R — you can independently write queries, build models, and extract insights from large datasets without relying on others
- Mastery of spreadsheet tools and data (Google Sheets / Excel) — pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and scenario analysis are second nature to you
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling executive narratives
- Deep experience with GTM systems like Salesforce and business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.)
- Proven executive stakeholder management skills — you have a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and VP-level leaders in high-intensity environments.
- An ability to pull signal through noise and an internal drive to create clarity. You strive for simplicity as the most elegant solution to complex situations.
- A demonstrated ability to build trust with and influence a variety of stakeholders, including colleagues and other members of the GTM Strategy and Revenue Operations team
- A healthy balance of idealism with pragmatism and the highest internal bar for excellence. You have been accountable for the results of your recommendations.

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

 - Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness

 - Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools

 - Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders

 - Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation

 - Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting

 - AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier

 - Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process
